messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Mills <jmills@sigma-ware.com>, Taylor Ruiz <t.ruiz@sigma-ware.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft — POC connectivity milestone & action matrix

Jordan / Taylor — thanks again for the call earlier. Per our discussion, I’m sharing a focused draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that captures the POC environment setup milestone and the dependencies you flagged. I pulled this into a simple action matrix so we can assign owners and establish target dates. I attached the MAP-draft-v2.xlsx and a quick VPC diagram.

High level recap (POC connectivity milestone):
- Goal: Provide a sandbox Redwood Private environment reachable from SigmaWare staging for 2-week functional POC.
- Target POC window: Aug 2–Aug 16 (tentative).
- Acceptance criteria: model inference end-to-end with sample dataset, <500ms median token latency for 32-token prompts, logs visible in your SIEM.

Key dependencies we captured on the call (we need owners / earliest availability):
1) VPC peering & route propagation — SigmaWare network team to approve peering and route tables (allows connectivity to Redwood-managed subnet).
2) IP allowlist / egress rules — SigmaWare security to confirm IP ranges for Redwood egress; temporary NAT IPs for the POC possible.
3) SSO / SAML for test users — SAML metadata exchange; we need a test IdP account and SAML cert.
4) Secrets & KMS access — KMS key policy or a short-term symmetric key for POC (Redwood supports both).
5) Service account roles & minimal IAM — least-privilege worker role for model access.

Next steps I propose:
- Jordan/Taylor: confirm owners and earliest dates for items 1–4 by EOD Wed, Jul 7.
- Karthik/Ben: can you confirm internal lead and estimated ETA for creating the POC VPC and providing ephemeral egress IP list? If we can align, we’ll lock the POC start by Jul 13.

Please see the attached MAP-draft-v2.xlsx — column 'Owner' is empty where I need confirmation. I tried to keep the ask minimal for your teams. If the dates above are aggressive, tell me the earliest realistic start and we’ll adjust the acceptance window.

Thanks — happy to jump back on a 20-min sync if that helps.

—
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: MAP-draft-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), poc-vpc-diagram.png (image)

From: Jordan Mills <jmills@sigma-ware.com>

Cc: Taylor Ruiz <t.ruiz@sigma-ware.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft — POC connectivity milestone & action matrix

Thanks Maya — good summary and the diagram helps. Quick answers from our side: we’re generally aligned but have two blockers that may push the start by ~1 week unless we triage them.

Blocker A — VPC peering windows: our infra team is in a change freeze until Jul 12 for a platform upgrade. Peering config requires a maintenance window. Earliest plausible peering work is Jul 13–14.

Blocker B — SAML metadata: our identity team needs to validate Redwood's SP assertion before giving a test IdP account. They asked for the SP metadata file and a contact on the Redwood SSO team for cert rotation questions.

I’ll own coordinating with infra (peering) and Laura in identity for SAML. Taylor and I will confirm owners by Wed, Jul 7 as you requested, but expect the peering to be scheduled after Jul 12.

Also, for secrets/KMS — we prefer to issue a scoped, short-lived symmetric key for the POC rather than granting KMS admin rights. Are you able to provide instructions for that route?

Jordan
Jordan Mills
Head of Platform Engineering | SigmaWare
jmills@sigma-ware.com | +1 (206) 555-8842

Karthik / Ben — forwarding Jordan's note (above). Two things I need:

1) Can Redwood internal infra create the sandbox VPC and provide the ephemeral egress IP list by Jul 13 if we schedule peering in that window? Karthik, is that realistic given current backlog? If not, propose earliest date.

2) Ben — Jordan prefers a scoped symmetric key for the POC rather than KMS admin. Can you outline the steps we’d provide to them (short checklist) and whether we can support rotation every 24–72 hours for the POC window? I added a short table in the attached MAP-draft-v2.xlsx with your rows highlighted. If you can reply with owners/ETA by Tue EOD (Jul 6), I’ll update the MAP and send back to Jordan & Taylor.

If any of this needs a quick 15-min sync I’m available Tue morning.

Thanks —
Maya

Subject: Updated MAP & proposed milestone dates — POC connectivity

Jordan / Taylor — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per internal check-ins, here’s an updated, concise action matrix and our recommended target dates. I’ve kept the POC start conservative to account for your maintenance freeze. Attached: updated MAP-draft-v2.xlsx (tab: ConnectivityActionMatrix) and ssm-kms-checklist.pdf.

Proposed milestone (finalized):
- POC connectivity readiness cutover: Jul 20 — Jul 22 (Redwood completes sandbox VPC + provides egress IPs; SigmaWare completes peering config in that window).
- SAML test binding & metadata exchange: Jul 16 — Jul 18 (identity teams exchange metadata and validate test account).
- Secrets provisioning (scoped symmetric key): Jul 19 (Redwood issues instructions; SigmaWare provides key details same day).
- Smoke test & validation window: Jul 23–25.
- POC functional start: Jul 26 (buffered to give time for verification).

Owners (as confirmed):
- VPC sandbox & egress IPs: Karthik Iyer (Redwood) — ETA: Jul 20
- Peering config & routing validation: Jordan / SigmaWare network team — ETA: Jul 22
- SAML metadata & test IDP: Laura (SigmaWare Identity) / Redwood SSO (Ben C.) — ETA: Jul 18
- Secrets & key exchange: Ben Carter (Redwood) / SigmaWare SecOps — ETA: Jul 19

Acceptance criteria reminder: end-to-end inference, logs ingest into SigmaWare SIEM, basic auth/SAML user flows, and sample dataset inference passing smoke tests.

Requested next actions:
- Jordan: confirm the owner for peering (if different from you) and confirm the maintenance window on Jul 20–22 by EOD Tue, Jul 6.
- Taylor: share contact info for Laura in identity if you haven’t already so Ben can share SAML metadata.
- Karthik/Ben: confirm readiness on your items (I marked the owner rows in the attached file).

If everything looks good, I’ll lock the MAP and send calendar invites for the peering and smoke-test windows.

Thanks all — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

—
